entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for a VeloBand.
Certainly, I can help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. Name is Alex Chen.

Thank you, Alex. Pulling that up now... okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on January 4th. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Look, it's not about the product. I've been out of town for an emergency. My brother had to have unexpected surgery and I've been at the hospital with him. I just got back and I missed the window to send it back.
I'm very sorry to hear about your brother's surgery, I hope he's recovering well. But there's no need to worry about the timing.
What do you mean? It's been 13 days. Don't you have some kind of 10-day policy?
Not at all, sir. According to our policy here, you are well within the 90-day return window. It's no problem at all. I can process this full refund for you right now.
Oh. Okay, then. That's easier than I thought. Yes, please process it.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
The email just came through. I've got it. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Alex?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit and I wish your brother a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
